gt_source: src/app/docker-compose.yml (includes per-service src/*/docker-compose.yml) plus src/app/compose.override.yaml, cross-checked with src/app/helmfile.yaml values, and each service's config defaults and client/repository wiring (ui StoreServices/ProxyController/TopologyController + application.yml, cart DynamoDBConfiguration, catalog config.go/main.go/repository, checkout configuration.ts/checkout.module.ts, orders DataSourceConfig/RabbitMQMessagingConfig).

edges.mechanism: Java/Spring: Kiota CatalogClient over OkHttp with base URL retail.ui.endpoints.catalog (env RETAIL_UI_ENDPOINTS_CATALOG=http://catalog:8080 from compose override); also /proxy/catalog and /topology via WebClient
Java/Spring: Kiota CartClient with base URL retail.ui.endpoints.carts (env RETAIL_UI_ENDPOINTS_CARTS=http://carts:8080; compose service 'cart' has hostname 'carts'); also /proxy/carts and /topology
Java/Spring: Kiota CheckoutClient with base URL retail.ui.endpoints.checkout (env RETAIL_UI_ENDPOINTS_CHECKOUT=http://checkout:8080); also /proxy/checkout and /topology
Java/Spring Cloud Gateway ProxyExchange forwards /proxy/orders/** to retail.ui.endpoints.orders, and TopologyService WebClient polls it (env RETAIL_UI_ENDPOINTS_ORDERS=http://orders:8080)
Java/Spring AI BedrockProxyChatModel (AWS SDK, region from retail.ui.chat.bedrock.region); only when retail.ui.chat.enabled=true and provider=bedrock (default disabled)
Go GORM mysql driver; provider RETAIL_CATALOG_PERSISTENCE_PROVIDER=mysql, endpoint RETAIL_CATALOG_PERSISTENCE_ENDPOINT=catalog-db:3306 from compose (code default in-memory)
Go opensearch-go client to RETAIL_CATALOG_SEARCH_OS_ENDPOINT=http://opensearch:9200; only when RETAIL_CATALOG_SEARCH_ENABLED (compose ${SEARCH_ENABLED:-false}, helm search.enabled false)
Java AWS SDK DynamoDbClient with endpointOverride RETAIL_CART_PERSISTENCE_DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://carts-db:8000 (dynamodb-local); provider dynamodb set in compose (code default in-memory)
NestJS/TypeScript ioredis RedisCheckoutRepository; RETAIL_CHECKOUT_PERSISTENCE_REDIS_URL=redis://checkout-redis:6379 from compose (code default in-memory)
NestJS/TypeScript HttpOrdersService (generated OrdersApi) with endpoint RETAIL_CHECKOUT_ENDPOINTS_ORDERS=http://orders:8080 (compose override; helm http://orders:80)
Java Spring JDBC/Hikari jdbc:postgresql://<RETAIL_ORDERS_PERSISTENCE_ENDPOINT>/orders with endpoint orders-db:5432 from compose (code default in-memory)
Java Spring AMQP RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend to fanout exchange (and listener on its own queue); RETAIL_ORDERS_MESSAGING_RABBITMQ_ADDRESSES=rabbitmq:5672 from compose
